criteria.text: Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.3 is stated as $30,000,000 but 20% of the $120,000,000 Purchase Price is $24,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Larkspur Energy plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,200,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Lists a confirmatory IP assignment from Larkspur Energy plc as a required third-party action not yet obtained.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (20% x $120,000,000 = $24,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $30,000,000.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
